entities.name: Xanthine phosphoribosyltransferase
observations: The 193-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed Streptococcus pneumoniae xanthine phosphoribosyltransferase references Q04IV9 and Q8DNL1; identity and coverage are 100%.
UniProt EC annotation is EC 2.4.2.22, with Rhea reaction mapping RHEA:10800.

entities.name: Xanthine salvage to XMP
observations: RHEA:10800 records the reversible phosphoribosyl-transfer reaction: xanthine + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate ⇌ xanthosine 5'-monophosphate + diphosphate.
The forward salvage direction incorporates xanthine into XMP for reuse in nucleic-acid synthesis.
